prompt.alinti: If you build with Claude code and you're not using these six phrases, you're building 10 times slower than you could be.
The first one is launch sub-agents.
So instead of Claude working through everything one job at a time, it splits the work across several agents that all run at once.
The second is write me an implementation spec.
Claude has to lay out the entire plan before it ever writes anything, which means you catch the bad decisions early.
You don't have to come up with a perfect prompt because Claude just asks you the questions it needs answered.
The fourth is verify before you build.
This makes Claude work out how it will check the result up front. So it can't just tell you that it's finished.
The fifth is based on this conversation, build me a skill.
It takes something you've already solved and turns it into a workflow that you can run again.
And the last one is automate this,
which gets Claude running your repetitive jobs without you. So just be careful what you point it out.
If you comment phrases, I'll send you all six as full prompts.

yontem.ne: Çalışmayı birden fazla agent arasında bölerek paralel işleme sağlar.

Kullanıcıdan sorular sorarak doğrudan prompt oluşturma ihtiyacını ortadan kaldırır.
Sonuç doğrulaması için önceden plan yaparak sonucun doğruluğunu garanti altına alır.
Çözülen bir problemi tekrar kullanılabilir bir akışa dönüştürür.
